summary: Fly Cell Atlas 10x (Li et al. 2022, Science), rebuilt from ArrayExpress E-MTAB-10519 and the authors' own per-tissue 10x Stringent AnnData analyses (flycellatlas.org), replacing the old SCEA-based loads FBlc0003846, FBlc0004307 and FBlc0004785 (split by sex); the Smart-seq2 data (E-MTAB-10628) are a separate project, li_2022_fca_ss2. Single-nucleus 10x data from 15 tissues plus whole head and body (61 Samples, 160 Assays). 17 Clusterings, one per author analysis, with one Cluster per author annotation: 370 clusters, 335 mapped to 190 distinct FBbt terms and loaded, 35 held. Summary expression for the loaded Clusters as CPM (16,363 genes x 506,660 cells; 512,215 cluster x gene rows with extent > 0.2).

decisions.decision: Rebuild the Fly Cell Atlas from the authors' own per-tissue analyses (flycellatlas.org h5ad) and ArrayExpress, one project per accession (E-MTAB-10519 10x here, E-MTAB-10628 Smart-seq2 in li_2022_fca_ss2), replacing the old SCEA-based loads FBlc0003846, FBlc0004307 and FBlc0004785 (split by sex).

Load complete sets: the 10x Stringent per-tissue analyses (17, including head and body) and the Smart-seq2 per-tissue analyses; the relaxed, integrated, cross-tissue and 'All' analyses are left out. One Cluster per author annotation (obs `annotation`) per tissue analysis.

Samples from the ArrayExpress SDRF with curator-reviewed tissue terms (a Sample overlaps, RO:0002131, its tissue term) and FBdv stages. Stocks from the supplement: only UAS-lamGFP has one (FBst0007378).
SDRF correction (sdrf_corrections): fat body age corrected from 3 to 5 days, per the supplement.

Map to FBbt (2026-10-01) once per author type (252 types, type_mapping/) and copy to each cluster of that type: 135 types with a single current author cell term confirmed by script (22 upgraded to the adult variant), 117 types via cell-type reports and map-clusters-to-fbbt subagents.
Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held), and never narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue.
Manual edit: 'adult antenna glial cell' mapped to adult PNS glial cell (FBbt:00058258, broad) rather than held.
Manual edit: 'antimicrobial peptide-producing cell' mapped to antimicrobial peptide-producing plasmatocyte (FBbt:00059377, exact) rather than held.
Manual edit: 'visceral muscle of the crop' mapped to adult crop circular muscle cell (FBbt:00003532, exact), replacing foregut muscle cell (broad).
Manual edit: 'corpora cardiaca cell' mapped to adult Akh secreting cell (FBbt:00058019, exact; the data are adult), replacing Akh secreting cell.
Manual edit: 'posterior midgut*' mapped to enterocyte of posterior adult midgut epithelium (FBbt:00007037, exact), replacing adult midgut epithelial cell (broad).
Mapping reviewed by the curator. Author types: 175 exact, 65 broad, 1 narrow, 11 held (plus the 'unannotated' and 'artefact' clusters, held). No FBbt term requests.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset, including ones whose authors ship normalised values (converted back to CPM).

Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows; previously minted ids removed from the registry and never reused). Here 35 held entries (17 leftover 'unannotated', 4 'artefact', 14 clusters of author types with no FBbt term), 335 Clusters loaded. Their cells still count towards the Dataset's total and filtered gene counts (16,363 / 12,747), which measure what the experiment detected.

Expression from the authors' raw.X (log(counts per 10,000 + 1)) converted to CPM; level is the mean CPM over expressing cells, extent the fraction of expressing cells, rows kept with extent > 0.2. Genes are keyed by symbol: the FBgn from the 10x files where given, else looked up in FlyBase Chado (FB2026_03); 16,270 current, 80 secondary, 15 synonym, 1 split id dropped, 2 merges.

Sample labels gain the authors' sample number (FCA4 ...), as 9 groups of Samples were otherwise alike; Assays are labelled '<Sample>, 10x library <S-index>', with the full library id kept as a dbxref (previously the label was the accession or library id). Ids unchanged.

Narrow by dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the term exact (refines the 2026-10-08 rule): head 'adult fat body' -> adult pericerebral fat cell (head fat is exactly the pericerebral fat mass) and body 'cell body glial cell' -> adult VNC cell body glial cell (cell body glia are CNS-only); recorded as cluster-level curator edits. Head perineurial/subperineurial glia and body fat stay generic (not exact). Reviewed 2026-10-16.
Revisit the fat mappings (adult fat cell, adult pericerebral fat cell) when FBbt issue #2218 (review adult fat terms) is fixed and released; tracked in checks/pending_fbbt_requests.json.

checks.check: verify_mappings.py and OLS lookups: every FBbt, FBdv and FBcv term used checked against the releases listed (FBbt 2026-10-01, FBdv 2026-09-30, FBcv 2026-10-01).
checks.result: All terms current: 190 distinct FBbt terms in the mappings; the FBbt/FBdv/FBcv terms on Samples, Assays and the Dataset (shared with li_2022_fca_ss2: 30 in all) current.

checks.check: CPM conversion of the authors' raw.X (log(counts per 10,000 + 1) -> CPM): per-cell CPM totals must have a median within 0.99e6-1.001e6 and none above 1.001e6, in every analysis.
Cluster sizes read from the h5ad files compared with cell_type_annotations.json (enforced by the expression build).
Marker spot checks in the expression output.
checks.result: ey and Pka-C1 in Kenyon cells (head Kenyon cell extent 0.59 / 0.73), SP in male accessory gland main cells (0.70), fzo in late primary spermatocytes (0.54). Re-confirmed 2026-10-15 against the current expression.tsv.gz.

software.label: VFB production (neo4j)

software.label: FlyBase Chado

software.label: h5py

software.label: ROBOT
software.description: OFN to OWL/XML conversion (metadata and expression OWL).

models.label: Claude Opus 5.5

models.label: Claude Sonnet (agent default)
